obfuscation_indicators: may not be able to recapture
risk_summary: The disclosure is generally quantitative regarding revenue, margins, operating results, investment balances, and debt, but includes standard broad forward-looking disclaimers and several unquantified cost and demand risks. Business exposure remains elevated to cyclical infrastructure spending, oil and steel prices, customer demand, and seasonal purchasing patterns, although 2012 results improved and the company reported no debt or off-balance-sheet arrangements.
